profile.title: Profile
profile.pictureDescription: An image address Berry can load. Berry does not host uploads yet.
profile.emailDescription: Changing this needs a verification step Berry does not have yet.
profile.name: Full name
profile.aboutDescription: Agents working with you are given this as context. Written once, true everywhere.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: What you work on, and what you want agents to know.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: What this workspace is called, and what it tells its agents.
general.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these.
general.logoDescription: An image address Berry can load. Berry does not host uploads yet.
general.name: Workspace name
general.slugDescription: Fixed. It is in every link to this workspace, and Berry has no redirect from an old one.
general.descriptionDescription: What this workspace is for. Shown to people deciding whether to join.
general.contextDescription: Given to every agent working here, on top of what each one knows.
general.contextPlaceholder: House rules, conventions, and anything an agent should never do.
general.prefixDescription: The letters in front of every task number. Two to ten characters, starting with a letter.
general.prefixInvalid: Two to ten letters or digits, starting with a letter.
general.prefixFailed: The prefix could not be changed.
general.prefixConfirmBody: Every task reference in this workspace changes at once: {before} becomes {after}. Links and pasted references using the old prefix will no longer resolve.
general.leaveDescription: You lose access until someone invites you back.
general.leaveSoleOwner: You are the only owner. Make someone else an owner first, or delete the workspace.
general.leaveConfirmBody: You will lose access to {name} until someone invites you back.
general.leaveFailed: You could not be removed from this workspace.
general.deleteDescription: Removes it for everyone in it. This cannot be undone from the app.
general.deleteConfirmBody: Everyone loses access to {name}, its tasks, and its history. Type the workspace name to confirm.
general.deleteFailed: The workspace could not be deleted.

members.title: Members
members.inviteDescription: They join this workspace at the role you pick.
members.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created.
members.inviteTokenBody: Berry does not send mail, so this link is the invitation. It is shown once — Berry kept only a hash of it.
members.ownerOnly: only an owner can change this
members.roleFailed: That role could not be changed.
members.removeBody: {name} loses access to this workspace. Their tasks and comments stay.
members.removeFailed: That member could not be removed.
members.revokeFailed: That invitation could not be revoked.
members.joinLinksDescription: A shareable link anyone can use to join, at a role you fix in advance.
